question: Zero tolerance
options: A policy of refusing to accept any violation of rules
To have no interest in a task
To be very lazy at work
solution: The school has a zero tolerance policy towards bullying. नियमों के उल्लंघन पर बिल्कुल भी रियायत या छूट न बरतने की नीति (कठोर अनुशासन)।

question: Zip your lip
options: To speak in a very fast manner
To stop talking or keep a secret
solution: You better zip your lip about the surprise party. अपनी जु़बान बंद रखना या किसी बात को गुप्त रखना (मुँह पर ताला लगाना)।
